name: ASO Scanner
description: Agent Signal Optimization reference agent. Scans a public site or API across 34 checks and returns an Agent Readiness Report with a 0-100 ASO Score, maturity level, and prioritized fix plan. It also audits individual x402 v2 endpoints without spending. A hosted A2A endpoint is not published yet; the scanner currently runs locally as the @forgemeshlabs/aso-audit-mcp MCP server.

skills.name: Scan site for agent readiness
skills.description: Run a full ASO scan against a URL and return the Agent Readiness Report: score, level, six-pillar breakdown, and all 33 checks with evidence and recommendations.

skills.name: Get prioritized fix plan
skills.description: Return a prioritized remediation plan with templates for robots.txt, llms.txt, agent.json, and other ASO signals.
examples: Give me a fix plan to make my site agent-ready

skills.name: Check a single signal
skills.description: Run one specific ASO check, such as a2a-agent-card, llms-txt, or x402, against a URL.
examples: Check only the llms-txt signal for example.com

skills.name: Explain the ASO framework
skills.description: Return the ASO rubric: pillars, weights, maturity levels, and certification thresholds.
examples: Show me the ASO scoring rubric

skills.name: Audit x402 v2 endpoint
skills.description: Run a deterministic no-spend audit of one paid endpoint and return a score, grade, compliance verdict, per-check results, and observed protocol metadata.
examples: Audit https://example.com/paid for x402 v2 compliance

additionalInterfaces.description: Run locally in any MCP client: npx -y @forgemeshlabs/aso-audit-mcp
